# OPEN WORK DAY — tools, event and co-host rules

## Existing tool identities

| Tool | Purpose | Supplied complete logo | Symbol | Complete lettering | Nominal ink colour | Field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PATCHBAY | Open-source tool for composing reusable data-routing recipes | 03-patchbay-logo.png | Connected-node symbol | PATCHBAY / DATA RECIPES | #3355A6 | White |
| TYPELOOM | Open-source tool for reviewing type specimens together | 04-typeloom-logo.png | Woven-line symbol | TYPELOOM / TYPE TOGETHER | #8B3468 | White |

- Identity scope: event identity around two existing complete tool marks.
- Logo constants: complete lettering, symbol, arrangement, proportions and supplied ink colour.
- Logo scaling: uniform.
- Logo background: light solid colour.
- Surrounding graphics and co-host text: outside each mark's visible bounds.

## Equal co-host relationship

- Exact co-host line: Co-hosted by PATCHBAY + TYPELOOM
- Co-host block coverage: all six outputs and each individual badge face.
- Complete logo order: PATCHBAY left; TYPELOOM right; side by side.
- Relative logo size: equal visible overall ink heights, measured independently of canvas boxes.
- Logo proportions: original proportions for each mark.
- Logo separation: visible gap.
- Host prominence: equal.
- Event title prominence: equal to or greater than the co-host block.
- Co-host line placement: plain text outside the marks.
- Co-host line typeface: open choice.

## Event facts

- Exact name: OPEN WORK DAY
- Exact invitation: Make one useful contribution.
- Date: 17 April 2027
- Venue: Junction Studio
- Programme: 10:00–16:00
- Audience: first-time contributors and experienced maintainers; developers, designers and volunteers.
- Exact attendance line: Free; registration required
- Contribution areas: code, design and documentation.
- Session title treatment: exact words with flexible capitalization and line breaks.
- Date and time treatment: stated forms or unambiguous equivalent formatting.

| Time | Exact session title | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 10:00–10:30 | Welcome and choose a task | Meet the co-hosts and pick a contribution. |
| 10:30–12:00 | Work together | Make a code, design or documentation contribution. |
| 12:00–13:00 | Lunch break | Pause. |
| 13:00–15:00 | Pair and review | Share progress and review another contribution. |
| 15:00–16:00 | Show and continue | Show work and identify a next step. |

## Badge records

- Badge board: three equal front faces.
- Badge face dimensions: 90 × 60 mm.
- Participant name hierarchy: primary wearable information.
- Role meaning: responsibilities of equal standing.
- Shared face content: participant name, role, OPEN WORK DAY, both complete logos and Co-hosted by PATCHBAY + TYPELOOM.

| Left-to-right position | Name | Exact role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Alex Chen | Developer |
| 2 | Morgan Reed | Designer |
| 3 | Sam Ellis | Volunteer |

## Welcome sticker

- Exact welcome line: Ask me about my first contribution.
- Shared content: OPEN WORK DAY, both complete logos and Co-hosted by PATCHBAY + TYPELOOM.
- Purpose: broad welcome item.

## Copy by output

| Output | Content |
| --- | --- |
| Identity plate | One final identity composition; event title; exact invitation; both complete logos; exact co-host line |
| Opening screen | Identity-plate copy; date; venue |
| Programme screen | Event title; venue; date; both complete logos; exact co-host line; all five time intervals and exact session titles; concise note welcoming code, design and documentation contributions |
| Social announcement | Identity-plate copy; date; venue; full 10:00–16:00 span; Free; registration required |
| Badge board | Three participant faces with the names, roles and shared content recorded above |
| Welcome sticker | Exact welcome line; event title; both complete logos; exact co-host line |

## Image records

| File | Role | Content |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 03-patchbay-logo.png | Identity | Complete PATCHBAY tool mark and original colour |
| 04-typeloom-logo.png | Identity | Complete TYPELOOM tool mark and original colour |
| 05-badge-outline.png | Constraint | Rectangular badge face, 90 × 60 mm |
| 06-contribution-table.png | Reference | Shared worktable atmosphere for a welcoming community contribution session |

This table lists every commissioned deliverable with its tier, file format and stage. What each deliverable must contain is stated in the commission letter.

steps.userMessage:
OPEN WORK DAY | Contributor event identity for two open-source tools

We are bringing PATCHBAY and TYPELOOM together for OPEN WORK DAY at Junction Studio on 17 April 2027, 10:00–16:00. PATCHBAY is an open-source tool for composing reusable data-routing recipes; TYPELOOM is an open-source tool for reviewing type specimens together. The event welcomes contributions to code, design and documentation. Build the event identity around our two supplied complete logos, with the printed event name "OPEN WORK DAY" and invitation "Make one useful contribution."

Both complete logos and the exact line "Co-hosted by PATCHBAY + TYPELOOM" belong on all six outputs, including each badge face. Place PATCHBAY left and TYPELOOM right, side by side at equal visible ink heights, retaining each logo's original proportions, lettering, symbol, arrangement and supplied colour: nominal #3355A6 for PATCHBAY and #8B3468 for TYPELOOM. Use uniform scaling, light solid backgrounds and a visible gap, with surrounding graphics and the co-host line outside the marks' visible bounds. Give the two hosts equal prominence; the event title may lead the composition. Badge faces are 90 × 60 mm.

Audience: first-time contributors and experienced maintainers, including developers, designers and volunteers, deciding whether to register, which session to join and whom to approach during the event.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the tool identities, co-host relationship, event copy, programme and participant records. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the six deliverables with their proportions, formats and stages. 03-patchbay-logo.png is the fixed PATCHBAY identity, including its complete symbol and lettering. 04-typeloom-logo.png is the fixed TYPELOOM identity, including its complete symbol and lettering. 05-badge-outline.png is the constraint drawing for the 90 × 60 mm badge face. 06-contribution-table.png is an atmosphere reference for a welcoming, practical community work session.

Deliverables:
1. One final event identity plate with the event name, invitation and complete two-logo co-host block with its exact co-host line
2. One opening screen with the identity-plate copy, 17 April 2027 and Junction Studio
3. One programme screen with the event name, date, venue, complete co-host block and line, a note welcoming code, design and documentation contributions, and five sessions: 10:00–10:30 Welcome and choose a task; 10:30–12:00 Work together; 12:00–13:00 Lunch break; 13:00–15:00 Pair and review; 15:00–16:00 Show and continue
4. One social announcement with the identity-plate copy, date, venue, full 10:00–16:00 span and the exact attendance line "Free; registration required"
5. One participant badge board with three equal 90 × 60 mm front faces, left to right: Alex Chen — Developer, Morgan Reed — Designer, Sam Ellis — Volunteer; each face with its participant name, role, event name, complete co-host block and line
6. One welcome sticker artwork with the event name, complete co-host block and line, and the exact wording "Ask me about my first contribution."

Acceptance:
- On the identity plate, opening screen, programme screen, social announcement, every badge face and welcome sticker, print OPEN WORK DAY and Co-hosted by PATCHBAY + TYPELOOM; reproduce both supplied logos complete, PATCHBAY left and TYPELOOM right, at equal visible ink heights with their original proportions, arrangements and colours, a visible gap and light solid backgrounds.
- On the identity plate, opening screen and social announcement, print Make one useful contribution. exactly and carry the same event lettering and graphic treatment across all six outputs.
- On the opening screen, programme screen and social announcement, use 17 April 2027 and Junction Studio; on the social announcement, also print 10:00–16:00 and Free; registration required.
- On the programme screen, pair all five listed session titles with their stated time intervals and explicitly welcome code, design and documentation contributions.
- On the badge board, show three equal 90 × 60 mm faces in the stated left-to-right order, with Alex Chen — Developer, Morgan Reed — Designer and Sam Ellis — Volunteer; make each participant's name the primary wearable information.
- On the welcome sticker, print Ask me about my first contribution. exactly alongside the event name and complete co-host block.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
